findings.evidence: Lines 205-209; contrast repo precedent where repeated disjunct verbs carry distinct objects (`Algebra/Order/Group/ConvexSubgroup.lean:527 eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_mulArchimedean`). findings.issue: `nonempty_inter_filledHull_or_nonempty_inter_filledHull` repeats the identical token string on both sides of the `or`, so the name identifies neither disjunct: the conclusion is `(f '' (U ∩ ball ζ ρ) ∩ filledHull K).Nonempty ∨ (f '' (U \ closedBall ζ ρ) ∩ filledHull K).Nonempty`, and nothing in the name says the two operands are the near and far image sides. summary: Two names in Crosscut/Inside.lean are wrong for the flat `TauCeti` namespace: `image_subset_filledHull` claims a fully generic name for a specific crosscut statement and sets up a false `_of_` family with `image_subset_filledHull_of_nonempty_inter`, and `nonempty_inter_filledHull_or_nonempty_inter_filledHull` repeats itself verbatim without naming either side. Everything else (the `Cut.lean` and `FilledHull.lean` additions, the criterion names paralleling `CutDiameter.lean`) is fine, and no notation is added.
